text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Country
text_block_list.text: Hmm… so where's Tracen Academy s'posed to be again? This city's way too big…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you a new student here?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Country
text_block_list.text: Sure am… I'm s'posed to st—w-wait! A-aren't you Yukino Bijin?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've heard of me?! I'm head'n back t'campus now, so you're welcome t'join me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Country
text_block_list.text: S-s-so this is Tracen Academy! Thanks oodles! I never coulda gotten here on my own!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No problem. ♪ I know the city can feel like a maze sometimes, what with all the buildings and everyth'n.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume from the Country
text_block_list.text: It sure can… I came here t'run in the centrals like you, but I'm off to a terrible start.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I was the exact same way when I first got here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But then I met my trainer, and they've really helped me get my bear'ns.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Li'l by li'l, they've helped me build up my conf'dence till I became the racer I am today! So I'm sure you'll do just dandy too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Only 'cause a certain someone helped me be who I wanna be. ♪ And I know you've still got a whole buncha lessons in store for me!
